workflow.title: Route tickets: refund replies, one daily digest to Zara
workflow.goal: For open support tickets: send the standard refund reply to the customer for every ticket mentioning 'refund'; send Zara one morning digest email that lists urgent open tickets and the other open tickets.

assumptions: Only tickets with status 'open' are handled.
The standard refund reply goes to the ticket's sender (the customer's 'from' address), not to Zara.
A ticket mentioning 'refund' in subject or body gets the refund reply, whether or not it is urgent.
Zara receives exactly one email per run: a digest with an urgent section and an other-tickets section, even when one or both are empty.
The other-tickets section covers open, non-urgent tickets that do not mention 'refund'.
Scheduling each morning is done outside this workflow by running it once a day.
risks: Automatic replies go to customers; each outbound send requires a person's approval.
Matching 'refund' is a simple text match and may catch tickets that are not really refund requests.
Recipient list audit only covers messages sent in this run.
successCriteria: Every open ticket mentioning 'refund' gets exactly one refund reply to its sender.
Zara receives exactly one digest email at zara@widgetly.app containing the urgent open tickets and the other open tickets.
Outbox audit confirms the recipients and message bodies.
